photos.desc: Rapistrum rugosum in commune of Narbonne, Aude, France

Introduced, cool-season, annual or biennial herb, mostly 15–60 cm tall, branches ± glaucous, often bristly. Lower leaves are to 25 cm long, lyrate-pinnatisect with usually 3 pairs of irregularly tooth
